titleText: Black Friday website aims to ‘bridge the gap’ between consumers and businesses
mainText: From Times of Malta: Black Friday website aims to ‘bridge the gap’ between consumers and businesses. Over 80 local businesses featured on The Malta Chamber of SMEs Black Friday website, with 450 vouchers up for grabs

titleText: PA approves 40 flats at Libyan school despite breaches of planning standards
mainText: From Times of Malta: PA approves 40 flats at Libyan school despite breaches of planning standards. Development in Ta’ Giorni includes apartments as small as 40 square metres

titleText: Two Pembroke sites to be transformed into recreation area and dog park under Lands Authority deal
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Two Pembroke sites to be transformed into recreation area and dog park under Lands Authority deal. Two parcels of public land in Pembroke are set to be handed over to the Pembroke Local Council for development into a recreation zone and a dog park, following an agreement signed with the Lands Authority.

titleText: Somewhere to go when there’s no one to talk to
mainText: From MaltaToday: Somewhere to go when there’s no one to talk to. “Hi, are you okay?” This is how social worker Katalin Horti often starts a conversation with someone walking into YMCA Malta’s drop-in centre in Ħamrun.

titleText: PM defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges
mainText: From The Malta Independent: PM defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges. Prime Minister Robert Abela has defended the government's economic model, insisting that Malta continues to perform strongly despite the economic challenges facing countries across Europe.
